name: models/kenney-city-kit-commercial/*.glb
note: GLB models only (FBX/OBJ duplicates in the pack were not extracted) plus Models/GLB format/Textures/colormap.png and the pack's own License.txt.

name: models/kenney-city-kit-roads/*.glb
note: GLB models only, plus colormap.png and License.txt. Road-tile geometry (road-straight, road-bend, tile-*, etc.) is included but is not expected to be used as-is — this project generates its own road mesh from RoadPath/RoadBuilder; the street-furniture pieces (traffic-light*, light-curved/light-square*, electricity-pole/side/wires*, road-sign*, bridge-pillar*, dumpster, construction-*) are the ones likely to matter.

name: models/kenney-car-kit/*.glb
note: GLB models only, plus colormap.png and License.txt. sedan/sedan-sports/suv/suv-luxury/taxi/hatchback-sports/delivery/van/truck are the likely parked-car dressing; ambulance/firetruck/police/garbage-truck read as city-service vehicles; kart-*/race*/debris-* are unrelated to this task and can be ignored.

name: textures/Facade001/*, textures/Facade009/*
note: Glass curtain-wall facades for the Loop/Streeterville skyscrapers (Willis Tower area, generic office towers). Color/NormalGL/Roughness/Metalness JPGs only — Displacement, AmbientOcclusion, .blend/.usdc/.mtlx/.tres and the ambientCG preview PNG were dropped.

name: textures/Travertine009/*
note: Michigan Avenue classic limestone/travertine facade stone.

name: textures/CorrugatedSteel009/*
note: Lower Wacker structural steel / loading-dock roller doors.

name: textures/Metal063/*
note: Weathered/rusted metal for bridge structure and fire escapes.

name: textures/GlazedTerracotta001/*
note: Chicago-School glazed terracotta facade cladding (Wrigley Building-style).

name: textures/PaintedMetal004/*
note: Painted steel for bridge houses, lamp posts, rail structure.

name: roadmap/downtown-roads.json
source: OpenStreetMap contributors, via Overpass (query in roadmap/README.md)
note: All highway=* ways (motorway through service, plus link ramps) in the downtown bounding box, not just the named CHI-01 route streets.

name: roadmap/downtown-buildings.json
source: OpenStreetMap contributors, via Overpass (query in roadmap/README.md)
note: building=* ways and relations (footprints, and building:levels/height where tagged) in the same box.

name: roadmap/downtown-water-leisure.json
source: OpenStreetMap contributors, via Overpass (query in roadmap/README.md)
note: Chicago River (waterway=riverbank), Lake Michigan and other natural=water, parks/leisure=park and landuse=grass, and bridge=yes ways.

name: roadmap/downtown-landmarks.json
source: OpenStreetMap contributors, via Overpass (query in roadmap/README.md)
note: Named POIs/artwork/attractions plus explicit name-matched nodes/ways for Willis Tower, Navy Pier, Cloud Gate, Millennium Park, Buckingham Fountain, Trump Tower, Marina City.
